positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead a Timeseries Monitoring and Alerting Platform
  - Build/improve a monitoring, detection, and alerting platform
  - Research/develop innovative and powerful timeseries anomaly detection algorithms
  - Use correlation analysis and PCA to detect unmonitored areas of datasets, and suggest to users which metrics to monitor

Intelligent Code Breakage Detector:
  - Designing and building a machine learning driven tool to intelligently predict which parts of recently submitted coded led to a current breakage.
  - Developing and storing an informative training dataset to train this predictive model.

positions.title: Project Coordinator
positions.description:
-Worked along side the Amgen Biosimilars Team
-Researched past clinical trials performed to approve a competitor's drug to better understand the parameters required to get a biosimilar of the drug approved
-Helped build content for the Amgen Biosimilar's Website

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	Worked with the advertising team to identify patterns and indicators of poorly performing campaigns
•	Built a tool in tableau that uses these patterns/indicators to allow campaign managers to easily detect not only poorly performing campaigns but also healthy campaigns with the end goal of inventory reallocation.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	Wrote code in Python that was implemented into various platforms of the company’s product
•	Analyzed large data bases of consumer information to uncover useful retail patterns and help the customer adjust their online advertising strategy

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description: •	Tutoring elementary and middle school students in math

positions.title: Co-head of Student Collaboration Section
positions.description: •	Worked with the MoonRise Proposal Team to design an unmanned mission to the far side of the moon for NASA’s approval
